subject: ENTRY-CONVENTION clause
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 11.9.7.4 a) "If a class definition includes the INHERITS clause, the entry convention is inherited from the first class specified", b) "If an interface definition includes the INHERITS clause, the entry convention is inherited from the first interface", c) "In all other cases, the entry convention is COBOL" -> all OK GR4). Every class/interface an INHERITS clause can name must be defined in the compilation group (COBOL0821 otherwise, measured with INHERITS FROM BASE) and every such element's convention is COBOL (other names refused COBOL2385), so the inherited convention in a) and b) is COBOL by construction; c) absent clause -> COBOL, the one convention (the bound OPTIONS model has no entry-convention field, kb/Work PB298). Verified: p4 (ECDER INHERITS FROM ECBASE, no clause) invokes the inherited method; p6 (interface ECIB INHERITS FROM ECIA) compiles/runs; consistent with §11.9.4 GR1 (cite OK). The golden pb232_entry_convention_cobol exercises only arm c) (contained W56ECIN with no clause); arms a)/b) untested -> test-ref empty. Correct vacuously while only COBOL exists (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DRV-GR-11.9.7.4-4, contingent on the single convention); if an entry-convention-name is ever admitted, the OPTIONS model gains an entry-convention field together with its consumer (OptionsModelConsumerDriftTests refuses the field alone), that consumer applies the INHERITS inheritance of arms a) and b), and the row is re-adjudicated. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2014, 2023 (the 2023 Annex E lists no introduction or change of the clause, so it predates 2023; whether ISO 1989:2002 carried it is not derivable from specs/ISO_COBOL.md -- the code gates it 2014 as a recorded conservative choice, constructs.json options-entry-convention-2014) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/OptionsBinder.cs#EntryConventionOf (kb/Work PB298: the ENTRY-CONVENTION screen returns nothing now that the clause has no model field, so EntryConventionOf became ScreenEntryConvention (the same SR1 + GR3 checks, COBOL2385); kb/Work PB298: OptionsModel.EntryConvention was read by nobody (the screen admits only COBOL, the implied convention of GR4 c), so the field is deleted; OptionsModelConsumerDriftTests keeps a producer-only OPTIONS field out) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/OptionsModel.cs#EntryConvention (kb/Work PB298: the ENTRY-CONVENTION screen returns nothing now that the clause has no model field, so EntryConventionOf became ScreenEntryConvention (the same SR1 + GR3 checks, COBOL2385); kb/Work PB298: OptionsModel.EntryConvention was read by nobody (the screen admits only COBOL, the implied convention of GR4 c), so the field is deleted; OptionsModelConsumerDriftTests keeps a producer-only OPTIONS field out)
